summary: Iteration 68 - Banks Module Redesign Complete. All backend APIs (11/11 tests passed) and frontend UI features working correctly. Bank listing now shows horizontal rows instead of grid cards. New fields (RIF, bank_code, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_email, bank_logo_url) fully functional. Logo upload with resize working.
seed_data_creation: Test banks created and deleted during testing (TEST_Banco UI Test 68, TEST_Banco Prueba Iteration 68)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Banks module redesign verified. New features: 1) Horizontal row layout (replaces grid cards), 2) Logo upload area with drag & drop (resizes to 100x100 via PIL), 3) New fields: RIF, bank_code, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_email, bank_logo_url - all optional. 4) Payment method chips display correctly. 32 existing banks in database. Static files served from /api/uploads/bank_logos/.

horizontal_row_layout.description: Banks displayed in horizontal rows with 4 blocks (Logo, Fiscal Info, Payment Chips, Contact+Actions)

logo_upload_endpoint.description: Accepts image files, resizes to 100x100 using PIL, returns logo_url

new_bank_fields.description: All new fields are optional and work in create/update/get

payment_method_chips.description: 100+ payment method chips displayed correctly in bank rows

drag_drop_logo_upload.description: Logo upload area supports drag & drop and click to select

edit_dialog_prefill.description: Edit dialog pre-fills all fields including new ones (RIF, bank_code, contact info)

delete_confirmation_dialog.description: Delete shows confirmation dialog with bank name, irreversible warning
